page.overview:
Who is Dolan Thrym?

Dolan Thrym is a human man and the High-Richter of Zadash. He was also the de facto leader of The Knights of Requital. As an NPC, Dolan was played by Matthew Mercer.

Dolan is a short, thin man with greying unkempt hair, small spectacles he wore on the edge of his nose, and unshaven stubble on his chin. He wore a nice white shirt he had tucked in.

Dolan seems polite but harbors ambitions of wielding influence that he keeps somewhat secret. When situations turn dire, Dolan's response is to protect Horris from harm.

At some point in his past, Dolan earned an art degree.
